notes.title: Notice on Delayed Update and Re-Release
notes.notes:
The game is currently heavily pirated. To prevent new content from becoming exclusive to pirate copies, I’ll need to resume sales.
I plan to start the re-release process in June, so the update will come after that.

※ If you already own the game, you won’t need to buy it again — updates will still be delivered as usual.

notes.title: Release and Patch Notes (V1.05)
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Q9nTWhwX4B0;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is officially released.
Yesterday, I tried to mess with my game using the most brute-force menu inputs—and sure enough, I broke it.

🛠️ V1.05 Bug Fix Notes

🎮 Camera and Menu Interaction Fixes:
The main issue showed up when I repeatedly pressed
Show Outfit >>> Sit Down—
It became painfully obvious something was off.

This update makes the game more stable overall.

Minor Adjustments:
Facial expression transitions are now smoother.
